03

Release Health Check — 2 weeks, fixed scope, fixed price.

What you get:

  • Measured DORA baseline — deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR + rework rate. Measured from your data (Git, CI, tracker), not surveyed.

  • Pipeline map — lead time per stage: where hours die between "ready" and "live".

  • Top-5 bottlenecks — each with evidence, monthly cost in €, and the recommended fix.

  • 90-day plan — executable by the team you already have.

  • 90-min workshop — findings presented to the team. No blame, no endless slides.

Not included: implementation. (If you want execution help afterwards, there's an advisory format — we talk after the diagnostic.)

FAQ

Remote?

Yes, async-first. Only 2 synchronous calls (45-min kickoff + 90-min workshop).

What access do you need?

Read-only: repository, CI logs, tracker export. No installation, no agent, no VPN.

What if our data is a mess?

That's a finding too — it goes in the report as an "observability gap", with a recommendation.

Who is this NOT for?

Teams looking for a hire disguised as consulting. I diagnose and plan; execution belongs to your team (or to advisory, later).
